The *Girinelapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 529) is a canonical Pali verse text located within the *Therāpadāna* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Belonging to the biographical apadāna genre, the poem commemorates the meritorious deeds and past associations of the elder Girinelapūjaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists translations of the work in five modern languages, though it provides no dedicated English title [SuttaCentral].
